turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Hey David, for the new checkout, we want users to save their billing information.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that last part. Can you say it again?

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Sure. Users should be able to save their billing information during checkout.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay. Do you mean we save it automatically?

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Not exactly. They should be able to choose whether to save it.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Ah, okay. So we need a checkbox for that?

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Got it. And should the checkbox be selected by default?

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: No, it should be unchecked by default.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay, just to clarify, users have to check it before we save their information, right?

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Cool. Let me know if anything else is unclear.
